goal: Provides a reference implementation of BIP460 to let developers aggregate Taproot signatures across inputs
Gives the BIP process a runnable prototype to evaluate before deciding whether to adopt cross-input signature aggregation
Enables second-layer protocols like payjoin and coinjoin to eventually shrink transaction size and cost
reviewability: Stale, labeled Needs rebase with a dirty mergeable state, a mechanical blocker
Author asked reviewers to focus on the core consensus/policy commits, not the still-evolving draft-bip commits
agreement: Unaddressed objection: signrawtransactionwithwallet can wrongly report complete=true for an incomplete aggregation input (BarneyChambers)
Unaddressed objection: combinepsbt silently drops a conflicting half-agg signature instead of detecting the conflict (BarneyChambers)
Unaddressed objection: finalizepsbt can build a second invalid aggregation group that consensus then rejects (BarneyChambers)
Author has been silent since before these review comments were posted
Author frames later draft-bip commits as unreviewed drafts not intended for merge (fjahr)
